# Synthetic OBS-14 fixture (not production data): a staging overlay that ships to Honeycomb.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: checkout
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: checkout
          image: example/checkout:1.0
          env:
            - name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
              value: https://api.honeycomb.io:443
            - name: OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER
              value: always_on
            - name: OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER
              value: otlp
            - name: LOG_LEVEL
              value: debug

# Synthetic OBS-14 fixture (not production data): QA compose file shipping to New Relic.
services:
  api:
    image: example/api:1.0
    environment:
      OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT: https://otlp.nr-data.net:4317
      OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES: service.name=api
      OTEL_SERVICE_NAME: api
  worker:
    image: example/worker:1.0
    environment:
      - OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT=https://otlp.eu01.nr-data.net/v1/traces
      - OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=parentbased_traceidratio
      - OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=1.0
      - OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=service.name=worker,deployment.environment.name=qa
